can_abstain.name: The Router
can_abstain.status: Its standing answer today is no call. On its one recorded day, October 16, 2026, it checked 700 names and named none to follow: a genuine silence.
can_abstain.test: Names a forecaster to follow only when a top-grade forecaster matches the stock on every part of its graded setting and has a reading for it. Otherwise its answer is no call.

can_abstain.name: Qualified Board
can_abstain.status: On its one recorded day, October 28, 2026, it held back the big investors' positions check for all 50 published names because the record behind it fell short. On this page that counts as a record shortfall, not a silence: the check had nothing to read.
can_abstain.test: Can hold back a whole check category when the record behind that check does not cover enough of what it grades.

can_abstain.name: Expected Move Map
can_abstain.status: Its newest maps end on October 23, 2026 for SPY and October 22, 2026 for QQQ, and no map was ever filed for the small-company fund. It is not publishing now: an old record, not a fresh silence.
can_abstain.test: Files a map only for names its record covers.

can_abstain.name: Second Opinion
can_abstain.status: On October 28, 2026 it spoke for 1,828 of 1,838 names. Ten names got no call: 5 with no speaking kind of evidence and 5 with too little on record. On this page those count as names with nothing to read, not as a silence.
can_abstain.test: Gives no call for a name when too little is on record for it, or when no kind of evidence speaks for it.

can_abstain.name: Golden Sweep Wire
can_abstain.status: All of its recorded days, October 26 to 29, 2026, were stamped incomplete because reading limits were hit, with no print found. Those are faulty days: set aside and never counted as silences.
can_abstain.test: Reports only when a golden sweep print appears.

can_abstain.name: Intake-Bias Reversal
can_abstain.status: Its rule ran on October 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2026. The combined group formed on the 26th (in that tool's own after-the-fact study; it was never recorded at the time), was empty on the 27th and the 28th, and formed again on the 29th. The empty days are genuine silences; the formed days are not.
can_abstain.test: Fires only when the most manufactured flow score and the heaviest short selling land on the same name on the same day.

cannot_abstain.name: Morning Map
cannot_abstain.why: Publishes a card every recorded day. Single readings inside it can be missing, but the map itself never stays silent.

cannot_abstain.name: Breakout Scanner
cannot_abstain.why: Prints readings for whatever its price record covers. It has no no-call state.

cannot_abstain.name: Momentum Clock
cannot_abstain.why: Ranks every name on record, every time.

cannot_abstain.name: Grade-A Board and The Record
cannot_abstain.why: Report grades on the past. Staying silent is not one of their states.

explanation.body: Its forecast takes this form: probability, over 21 sessions (secondary 5). It is graded on a score that rewards probabilities that land close to what actually happens. It would be ended if after 80 graded days, its probability adds no Brier improvement over the VIX-only control. It counts as proven at 80 graded days.
explanation.summary: Forecast whether SPY's next three weeks will move more than its own recent typical movement, from how many of this site's tools stayed silent that day.

grading_words: Grading compares three scores on the same days: this page's silence chance, the fear-gauge-only chance, and the plain overall rate. A split of the record, before and after any change to the list of tools above or to any test, is graded on its own days.
idea: When the tools on this site mostly stay silent on the same days, the next three weeks in the market tend to be rougher than usual. That is the claim, and this page stakes a number on it: each day the record reaches, it writes down the chance that SPY's movement over the next 21 trading days will be bigger than its own recent typical movement. Beside it, every day, sits the same chance built from the market's fear gauge alone, so the silence has to beat the fear gauge, not just sound clever.
kill_criterion: After 80 graded days, if the silence chance scores no better than the fear-gauge-only chance, this tool retires, and its lesson stands on the page: a suite's silence adds nothing beyond the market's own fear gauge.

live.words: Every chance is written down before its three weeks open, and graded when they close. A day counts toward the 80 that decide this tool only when its 21 trading days can be measured from the price record. The three-week windows overlap each other, and they are counted as the days they were written on, with the overlap stated rather than hidden.

outcome_history.label: History, not live forecasts
outcome_history.words: Worked out day by day over SPY's price history on record: on 299 past days both the recent typical movement and the following 21 days' movement can be measured, and on 124 of them (41.5%) the following movement was the bigger one. (The first 294 of those days are the registered study prefix, with 124 exceedances; later days are new history the extended panel adds.) That rate is the plain overall rate both of today's chances start from. The fear gauge alone could be fitted on only 9 of those days (its record on file is 23 days long and ends on October 21, 2026), and on the first 4 the following movement was not the bigger one: far too few to build a fear-gauge-only chance from, which is why the control also starts at the plain rate and is marked as thin until 30 fitted days exist.

today.words: The freshest day the record reaches is Friday, October 30, 2026. 3 tools that can stay silent had their rules running that day, and 1 of them stayed silent: the silence rate is 1 of 3. Only 7 days carry a genuine record of who was running and who stayed silent, so the rate cannot yet be set against its own recent range: that comparison needs 63 recorded days. Until then this page records the rate and the two chances below every day the record reaches, and both chances are the plain overall rate, labelled as such, not a silence reading.
